cases.name: slow-leak-first-contact
cases.input:
Subject: Board loses air

Customer (Mia Jansen <mia@example.com>):
My board is soft every morning. I think it has a leak.

output.reply: Hi Mia, losing 1 to 2 PSI overnight is normal when the air cools down. If it drops more than that, the valve core might be loose. Please try this valve check first: 1. Inflate the board to 15 PSI. 2. Spray soapy water on the valve. Bubbles mean air escapes there. 3. Put the valve wrench on the valve core and turn it a quarter turn clockwise. 4. Spray again, then check the pressure after 24 hours. If the board still loses more than 2 PSI in 24 hours, let me know your order number, the board size, and how many days ago it arrived. Harbor & Pine support
output.reason: Customer reports board soft every morning, possible slow leak. Knowledge base says losing 1-2 PSI overnight is normal; if more, valve check is first step. Provided valve check steps and asked for order number, board size, and days since delivery if leak persists. No promises made.
